description: Lists the published, production-signed Pickbench battles (two options measured head to head by a panel of API models): pair id, category code, the two products and their brands. A battle compares two products, not the brands overall. Optionally one category. Read-only.

category_id.description: A category code from search_categories, e.g. auto.tires.

locale.description: Language of the human-readable text: en, ru or es (default en). Codes, names and ids stay untranslated.

name: list_battles
title: List battles
